newsitem.title: POLAND: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR SYENITE MINING FIRM.
newsitem.headline: POLAND INVITES BIDS FOR SYENITE MINING FIRM.

text.p: Poland's privatisation ministry is inviting bids for at least 10 percent of the syenite rock mining and processing company Sjenit, the ministry said in a newspaper advertisement on Thursday.
It said 20 percent of the Gornicze Przedsiebiorstwo Przerobu i Ekspolatacji Kamienia SA would be earmarked for its employees and five percent for reprivatisation claims.
The dealine for bids is October 24, 1996.
The company, located in the south-western town of Pilawa Gorna, employs 196 people and had a sales of 1.66 million zlotys in the first half of 1996 against 5.04 million in the whole of 1995.
It has total assets of 4.56 million zlotys and its share capital is 1.62 million zlotys divided into 162,000 shares.
It excavated 97,000 tonnes of syenite rock in 1995.
